ideas.pitch: An AI-powered AML and compliance risk visualization platform utilizing graph intelligence to map suspicious fund flows across multiple decentralized finance protocols in real-time.
ideas.title: AegisGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy backend graph intelligence and data processing pipelines similar to Bito, proving serious engineering execution within a short window.

ideas.pitch: A local-first video intelligence platform that transforms unstructured meeting and security footage into searchable, vector-indexed semantic data without relying on paid heavy cloud APIs.
ideas.title: VisiQuery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the LibrAI winning architecture by converting multi-modal raw data into queryable intelligence, appealing to judges looking for high practical utility.

ideas.pitch: A systematic backtesting sandbox that uses customized chess engine evaluation scores and decision tree prompts as a deterministic proxy task to benchmark small LLM reasoning capability.
ideas.title: QuantEval Chess
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adopts the rigorous evaluation and benchmarking methodology of the PointChessEngine grand prize winner, focusing on hardcore metrics over fluff.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight clinical-grade diagnostic triage tool that integrates remote PPG heart rate extraction via webcam alongside multi-lingual offline symptom assessments for low-connectivity regions.
ideas.title: MedTriage Edge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven formula of SAGACITY and mediscan-ai by blending computer vision health metrics with high-impact social accessibility use cases.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent sustainability platform that uses LangGraph to coordinate decentralized data scrapers, generating automated carbon offset strategies and ESG compliance reports for local SMBs.
ideas.title: EcoGraph Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the multi-agent RAG architecture of the award-winning greennovation-ai-platform, hitting the sweet spot of structured workflow automation and environmental impact.
